verdict.rationale: Authy is an authenticator app and 2FA API service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The only programmatic surfaces are an SDK and the Authy API, which a probe shows is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
